title: TRICK FILME – Vom Zeichentrick zur Computergraphik (Scope 15/1985) / Animated films – from cel animation to computer graphics

notes: Austria, German: Austria Wochenschau 'Scope' 15/1985 from Maria Lassnig's animation studio at the Angewandte. Lassnig to camera and the rostrum stand, drawn animation, then Leopold Pohorely, Computer-Animations-Fachmann, at his CRT workstation with a stylus on the tablet, and the turn the title promises — colour vector buildings on a wireframe grid — closing on hand-drawn chalk titles. Fetched with yt-dlp (FilmArchiv extractor, format 1100 + audio); the burned-in FILM ARCHIV AUSTRIA corner logo and the lower-left 'Maria Lassnigs Trickfilm-Studio' caption were pre-cropped out (crop=400:300:84:0) before cutting; the modern Filmarchiv title and end cards (0-12 s, 290-317 s) are not used.
